## 📋 Checklist

**Before Submitting:**
- [ ] Read [ETHIK_MANIFEST.md](../../ETHIK_MANIFEST.md) (Bias-Log, Abbruchkriterien, Forschungs-Ethos)
- [ ] Check if bias is already documented (Bias-Log section)
- [ ] Suggest mitigation strategy (not just criticism)

**For Maintainers (after issue is opened):**
- [ ] Acknowledge issue within 48 hours
- [ ] Discuss in team/community (if applicable)
- [ ] Update `ETHIK_MANIFEST.md` Bias-Log (if new bias identified)
- [ ] Implement mitigation (code change, documentation update, or process change)
- [ ] Add to next Review-Checkpoint (Q1-Q4 2026)
- [ ] Close issue with summary of action taken
